name: Longboat Rower Lena

intro.text: In a gale the longboat is the only way off this island. We row it out beyond the surf, then it's all arms. A battle is just a boat race with sillier rules.

win: That's a good pull. You'd do well in the second crew.
after: Tristan's open longboats carry people and cargo out to the ships, which anchor beyond the surf. The landing place, Calshot Harbour, is named for the place in Hampshire where the evacuees stayed.
